findings.title: Silence action is a no-op in the ruler-less Grafana rule list
findings.body: In the new list view, RuleActionsButtons is rendered with only promRule and no ruler rule. AlertRuleMenu can show 'Silence notifications' because canSilence can be true from Grafana Prometheus abilities, and clicking it sets showSilenceDrawer. However, the silence drawer is only rendered when rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) is true; with rule undefined this condition never passes, so clicking Silence does nothing.

findings.title: Pause menu item is hidden for Grafana rules in the ruler-less list view
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu computes canPause from either ruler abilities or Grafana Prometheus abilities, but the Pause menu item is rendered only when rulerRule is a Grafana ruler rule. In the alert list view after removing ruler requests, rulerRule is undefined, so Pause will not be shown even when the user has permission to pause the Grafana rule.

findings.title: Delete menu item is hidden for Grafana rules in the ruler-less list view
findings.body: canDelete can be true from Grafana Prometheus abilities, but the Delete menu item is rendered only when rulerRule is truthy. In the ruler-less alert list view rulerRule is undefined, so users with delete permission cannot delete Grafana rules from the list. If deletion by UID is intended, this is a regression; if not, the ability should not be enabled.

findings.title: skipToken does not disable Grafana abilities and can enable Duplicate incorrectly
findings.body: useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities converts skipToken to undefined and calls useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined). That hook does not return all-false abilities for undefined; Duplicate becomes supported and allowed if the user has Grafana rule create permission. Because AlertRuleMenu ORs Grafana abilities with ruler abilities, non-Grafana rules may show Duplicate based on unrelated Grafana permissions.

findings.title: Federated rule groups are no longer treated as immutable
findings.body: useAllRulerRuleAbilities hardcodes isFederated = false, while previous CombinedRule logic used isFederatedRuleGroup to mark federated rule groups as immutable. Federated Mimir rules may now incorrectly appear editable, deletable, pausable, or duplicatable.

findings.title: Grafana recording rules lose pause/restore/delete-permanently abilities
findings.body: useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities gates Pause, Restore, and DeletePermanently on isAlertingRule. The previous ruler-based ability logic applied these actions to Grafana-managed rules generally, and Grafana recording rules expose isPaused. This change will hide pause/restore/permanent-delete actions for Grafana recording rules.

findings.title: Grafana rule list items are rendered without a React key
findings.body: In FilterViewResults.rules.map, the computed key is passed to DataSourceRuleLoader and UnknownRuleListItem, but the Grafana branch returns GrafanaRuleListItem without a key. This can cause React list reconciliation warnings and may cause component state to be reused by the wrong rule row when the list updates.

findings.title: Grafana rule key contains an extra closing brace
findings.body: getGrafanaRuleKey returns `grafana-${namespace.uid}-${groupName}-${rule.uid}}`, which adds an unintended trailing closing brace to every generated key. This appears to be a typo and produces malformed keys.

findings.title: Tests assert the limited ruler-less menu instead of covering missing actions
findings.body: The GrafanaGroupLoader menu test grants delete permission but asserts exactly four menu items, omitting Delete and Pause, and does not exercise the Silence action. This masks the ruler-less view regressions where Delete/Pause are missing and Silence can be a no-op.

findings.title: Component comment still says Ruler endpoint is used
findings.body: GrafanaGroupLoader's JSDoc says it loads an evaluation group from Prometheus and Ruler endpoints, but the Ruler query was removed in this change. The comment should be updated to reflect that only the Prometheus endpoint is used.
